name: dirbuster
summary: An application designed to brute force directories and files names on web/application servers
highlights: -l — The Word list to use for the list based brute force. Default: /home/kali/kali-www/bin/kali
-g — Only use GET requests. Default Not Set
-e — File Extention list eg asp,aspx. Default: php
-t — Number of connection threads to use. Default: 10
-s — Start point of the scan. Default: /
-P — Don't Parse html, Default: Not Set
-R — Don't be recursive, Default: Not Set
-r — File to save report to. Default: /home/kali/kali-www/bin/kali-tools/tool-output/dirbuster/
